Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Solar Flare impact tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Rune reasoning: Leona — Solar Flare impact: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: R3 is300+0.8AP magic; full AP and MR penetration test personal spell ceiling despite usual tank support role. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void provides40% MR penetration; Shadowflame pr Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Haste: Cooldown utility; no extra casts inside a one-cast benchmark. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Axiom targets eligible native ultimate output. Check single-target versus area classification, and pet/on-hit/transform/true-damage exceptions. Its takedown refund is not extra damage inside one fixed cast. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
coverageNotes: Rune review (2026-10-19): Optimize the named native single-hit benchmark; report rune proc output separately. No numerical/global optimum is certified; unsupported rune interactions and stat conversions require client tests. Separate all keystone, Scorch, Shield Bash, Font, and item proc output from the selected native metric. These are reasoned choices and comparison candidates; not a complete numerical rune solver or in-game verification.

builds.name: Eclipse: granted armor experiment
builds.summary: Investigate high Eclipse granted armor while active output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Eclipse granted armor while active output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: At rank 5 W lists 50 + 20% bonus armor as granted armor, with a separate 50 + 20% bonus MR helper. This experiment scores the armor stat increase, not a shield or the 175 + 0.4 AP explosion. Record actual before/after stats to avoid feeding the buff back into its own helper indefinitely.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Reference enemy (not the recipient of this self effect): 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Jak'Sho legally ramped through five seconds of real champion combat and still active. Aftershock inactive for the baseline; no ally resistance buffs or dragons. One W, record own armor immediately before and after cast and before the three-second initial duration ends. Observe three seconds, no renewed W casts.

Rune reasoning: Leona — Eclipse granted armor while active: The selected helper uses armor and/or MR. Conditioning is direct resistance value at minute 30. Aftershock and Unflinching are conditional resistance variants; AP/AD, attack speed and Shield Bash are not substitutes for the resist coefficient. Ability basis: At rank 5 W lists 50 + 20% bonus armor as granted armor, with a separate 50 + 20% bonus MR helper. This experiment scores the armor stat increase, not a shield or the 175 + 0.4 AP explosion. Record actual before/after stats to avoid feeding the buff back into Aftershock: Only real, timely immobilization grants the capped resist buff; do not improve its own triggering hit retroactively. Font of Life: Separate conditional recovery; it does not enlarge the named native heal, shield or attack packet. Conditioning: Minute-12 armor/MR; direct only for matching resistance scaling, otherwise survival utility. Unflinching: Conditional resistances require actual incoming CC and a matching timer; no permanently active bonus. Biscuit Delivery: Three earned consumed/sold biscuits add finite 90 HP; their heal is a separate event. Cosmic Insight: Item/summoner cooldown utility, not direct native ability output.

Rune preparation: Conditioning is active after minute 12. Baseline receives no Aftershock or Unflinching resistances unless the authored events really trigger them. A prepared comparison needs real immobilization before scoring and/or actual incoming CC inside the short buff timers. Same-hit Aftershock is not assumed to improve the hit that triggers it.

Rune comparison: Compare an Absolute Focus/Gathering Storm page when AP or AD also scales this helper, versus the real prepared resistance page. Measure client stats and caps instead of recursively multiplying resistance buffs.

Stat shards: Offense haste is utility for this stat/flat-coefficient objective; it is not extra damage per hit. Flex scaling health adds finite max HP; only a recorded HP coefficient or equipped conversion turns that into native output. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

kitEvidence.formula: Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by [8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24] and gaining [20 / 27.5 / 35 / 42.5 / 50 + (0.2) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2]] Armor and [20 / 27.5 / 35 / 42.5 / 50 + (0.2) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] Magic Resist for [3] seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing [55 / 85 / 115 / 145 / 175 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional [3] seconds.
